changed_factors: Refine RHBI to rhbi-v2 (parent rhbi-v1) under one unchanged global clock-free recipe: (1) switch Sinkhorn slack screening from logarithmic rapidity compression to pure linear Born-Infeld horizon screening (rhbi_rapidity_screening=false, rhbi_rho=3.0) so empty-valley midpoint particles (c_hat >> rho) route cleanly to local critic symmetry breaking instead of stalling in 50/50 cross-mode active couplings; (2) switch self-coupling debiasing from hollow derangement to Feydy diagonal-included Sinkhorn self-coupling (rhbi_self_coupling='feydy') so isolated batch singletons absorb self-mass along the zero-cost diagonal without intra-mode covariance inflation; (3) add small endpoint squared-gradient floor regularization (rhbi_lambda_floor=0.005) inside _RHBIPenaltyKernel to softly damp sub-unit critic slope chatter after mode capture; (4) switch global particle prior regularization from moment_tether (0.01) to degree-of-freedom-aware SBNP (prior_regularizer='sbnp', prior_reg=0.02) with lr=0.014, prior_lr_mult=2.9, and DualNorm polar smoothing optimizer_smoothing=0.0061 on polar_cpu_v1 for smooth post-convergence settling across scalar, multimodal, AE, and categorical/hard VAE hosts.
mechanism_rationale: In rhbi-v1, logarithmic rapidity screening 2*rho*log(1 + c_hat/(2*rho)) compressed empty-valley distances (c_hat ~ 13 on ring16_acquisition) below the slack threshold, trapping valley bridge particles in balanced 50/50 cross-mode OT pulls, while hollow self-coupling forced off-diagonal intra-mode derangements and tiny polar smoothing (0.001) left stochastic VAE/AE ELBO updates jittery at late steps. Linear Born-Infeld screening (rhbi_rapidity_screening=false, rhbi_rho=3.0) combined with Feydy self-coupling (rhbi_self_coupling='feydy'), soft sub-unit critic slope damping (rhbi_lambda_floor=0.005), SBNP prior regularization (prior_reg=0.02, prior_lr_mult=2.9), lr=0.014, and polar smoothing 0.0061 preserves exact scale-equivariant quadratic W2 intra-mode moments while routing valley outliers 100% to slack critic ascent and stabilizing late-step VAE/AE settling under one global constant-LR configuration.
